step4_smoke_on_real_server.route: teleport (224,-1408,32), PolicyDrive yaw=90, 30 s wall clock
step4_smoke_on_real_server.interpretation: LOOP PROVEN: obs->inference->usercmd->server->new obs closes at the server's own 77 Hz for the full 30 s, zero errors, and peak >320 means the policy exercised real air-acceleration on the live server. Speeds are low because the checkpoint is not done training (it holds jump every tick and never presses forward) — expected, and explicitly not what this smoke gates on.

budget_flag_p99_tick_cpu.constraint: p99 CPU per game tick < 0.5 ms (hard invariant, full per-tick path)
budget_flag_p99_tick_cpu.detail: obs build is fine (p99 116 us). tract inference p50 1.79 ms / p99 2.10 ms measured while the gate1_v1 GPU training run had the box at loadavg 40 on 64 cores; the quieter earlier bench on the same box saw p50 394 us / p99 1465 us. Must be re-measured on a quiet machine before any candidate ships; if still over, options are tract concurrency pinning, a distilled/smaller head, f16/quantization, or ort. Logged as open work, not excused.

deviations_and_assumptions: jump_held is not readable from the game module (engine keeps it per client); the driver mirrors PM_CheckJump's rule: !jump->false; jump while swimming/airborne->unchanged; grounded jump press->true. Exact on the corridor (no water); corner case: waterjump.

msec: the existing bot host truncates frametime*1000 (f32 12.999->12). The policy bridge rounds instead and sent msec=13 on 100% of ticks; the rest of the bot host was left as-is (measured fact worth its own fix, out of scope here).
view yaw/pitch are integrated in the driver (yaw += dyaw, pitch clamped [-70,80]) and never read back from the entity, exactly as the training env holds them.
PolicyDrive loads the ONNX on the engine thread at order issue (~66 ms one-time hitch) — never in the tick loop.
obs timer and inference timer are separate fields (obs_us, infer_us) in the tick log.

sim2real_gap_2026_07_30.symptom: harvested candidate (sim greedy peak 740-777) collapsed on the live server: peak 161.0, mean 60.7, jump pressed 1164/1164 ticks
sim2real_gap_2026_07_30.method: frozen-checkpoint pairing (pipeline/out/rl/bridge_diag/eval_snapshot, ckpt 000044354) + per-tick comparison: sim reference rollout (rl/ref_rollout_gate1.py, logs pre-step state + kin obs + greedy action) vs instrumented driver tick log (kin[16], raw box means, jump_held)

root_cause_1_tract_miseval.finding: tract-onnx 0.21.10 evaluates the exported graph as ≈ NEGATED output — both with the fused ONNX GRU node and with a primitive-op cell containing the Sub(1,z) pattern. torch row0 [-5.305,-0.668,...,8.061,-8.002] vs tract [+5.306,+0.653,...,-8.025,+7.965]; max|diff| 29.33; jump argmax INVERTED on 100% of ticks (the constant-jump symptom). onnxruntime on the SAME file matches torch exactly — the runtime, not the export, is guilty.
root_cause_1_tract_miseval.fix: rl/export_onnx.py now emits the GRU cell as primitive ops with the algebraically identical h' = n + z*(h-n) form (no scalar-minus pattern), plus a torch-vs-torch gate asserting the manual cell == forward_core. After the rewrite: tract == ORT == torch, max|diff| 1.43e-5, all argmax heads 100% equal over the 400 fixtures.
root_cause_1_tract_miseval.consequence: EVERY .onnx exported before this fix (gate1_v1_live.onnx, gate1_candidate.onnx) is broken under tract and must be re-exported. gate1_candidate_fixed.onnx (from the frozen snapshot) is the corrected artifact; the original gate1_candidate.onnx was left untouched.

root_cause_2_last_action_clamp.finding: rl/env.py stores the RAW unclipped policy box means in the last_action obs features (flat_action(box[0]*20)/20 = box[0], e.g. -4.32) while applying the clipped view delta; the driver stored the clamped value (±1). Measured |kin[10]| divergence up to 5.3 from tick 2 — corrupting the GRU input every tick.
root_cause_2_last_action_clamp.fix: spec::last_action_raw in rex-policy (regression test pins raw means through the block); driver uses it.

Export and evidence runs must pin a frozen snapshot — the bridge_diag/eval_snapshot pattern.
